sections.Comps:
A manager may comp up to $25 on a single ticket to resolve a complaint
about food quality or a long wait. Anything above $25 needs the owner, who
can be reached by text during service.

Comps for friends, family, or staff are not permitted at any amount. Staff
meals are handled separately under the staff meal rule below.

Total comps in a week should stay under 1% of that week's gross sales. If
a week runs over, the owner reviews every comp from that week.
sections.Refunds on in-store and online orders:
A customer with a receipt may have an in-store or Square Online order
refunded to the original payment method within 7 days of purchase. Cash
orders are refunded in cash; card orders are refunded to the card and never
in cash.

Without a receipt, offer a remake or a credit for the same amount, not a
refund. Credits expire after 60 days.

Orders placed through a marketplace are never refunded by us directly; see
the marketplace terms.
sections.Discounts:
Staff may apply the standard discounts on the register: 10% for students
and seniors with ID, and 15% for first responders in uniform. Any discount
above 15% on a single order needs a manager. Any discount above 30% needs
the owner, including on catering.

Discounts are not combined. The largest applicable discount applies.
sections.Staff meals:
Each staff member on a shift of five hours or more may have one meal from
the Noodle Soups, Rice Dishes, or Sandwiches categories at no charge, rung
in as a staff meal, not a comp. Specialty drinks and catering items are not
included.
sections.Catering:
Catering orders need 48 hours' notice and a 25% deposit at the time of
order. A catering order cancelled more than 24 hours before pickup gets the
deposit back. Cancelled within 24 hours, the deposit is kept. Catering
orders over $500 need the owner to confirm the kitchen can take them.
sections.Allergies:
Any order noting a nut, shellfish, or gluten allergy is made by the lead
cook and checked by a manager before it leaves the kitchen. We do not
guarantee any dish is free of these allergens and staff must say so when
asked.

sections.Commission and pricing:
DoorDash takes 25% of the menu subtotal on delivery orders and 15% on pickup.
Uber Eats takes 30% on delivery and 15% on pickup. Grubhub takes 20% on
delivery plus a 5% marketing fee, and 10% on pickup.

Menu prices on the marketplaces may be set up to 25% above our in-store
price to offset commission. They may not be set higher than that, and the
same item must carry the same price on all three platforms. Price changes go
through the owner.
sections.Missing or incorrect items:
When a customer reports a missing or incorrect item, the platform refunds the
customer directly and charges the cost back to us by default.

We can dispute the chargeback if we have a packing photo showing the item in
the bag. Photos are taken at the pass for every marketplace order over $40.
Dispute windows: DoorDash 7 days from the order date, Uber Eats 30 days,
Grubhub 14 days. A dispute filed after the window is rejected automatically.

If the order was over $40 and no packing photo exists, do not dispute; accept
the chargeback and log it as a packing miss.
sections.Late, cold, or damaged deliveries:
Delays and damage after the courier picks up are the platform's cost, not
ours. If a customer complains to us about a late or cold delivery, refer them
to the platform's support and do not issue a refund or a credit from our
side. The exception is a Grubhub order where we marked it ready more than 10
minutes before it actually was; that is counted as our delay and we accept
the chargeback.
sections.Cancellations:
An order cancelled by the customer before we confirm it costs nothing. An
order cancelled after we confirm it is paid to us in full by the platform,
except on Uber Eats, where orders cancelled within 2 minutes of confirmation
are not paid.

If we cancel an order because we are out of an item, we are not paid and the
platform may lower our ranking. Offer a substitution first; cancel only when
the customer declines.
sections.Promotions:
Platform promotions we fund ourselves (for example "$5 off orders over $30")
need owner approval if the expected cost is over $200 in a calendar month.
Promotions funded by the platform need no approval. Never run a funded
promotion on Grubhub, where the marketing fee already applies.
sections.Repeat disputes:
A customer with three or more refunded marketplace orders in the last 90
days is flagged. For flagged customers, every missing-item claim is disputed
regardless of order value, and the owner is told.

sections.Who may receive marketing texts:
A marketing text may only go to a customer who has verified SMS consent on
file, meaning they texted a keyword to our number or ticked the box on the
Square Online checkout and confirmed. Implied consent, meaning the customer
gave us a phone number when ordering but never opted in, is not enough for
marketing.

Implied consent does allow transactional texts: order ready, order delayed,
catering confirmation. Nothing promotional may be added to a transactional
text.

Anyone who has unsubscribed is never texted again for any reason, including
transactional messages, until they opt in again.
sections.Quiet hours:
No text of any kind between 8pm and 9am in the customer's local time. For
customers without a known local time, use Central time.
sections.Frequency:
At most four marketing texts to any one customer in a calendar month. Email
has no frequency cap but every email must carry an unsubscribe link.
sections.Offers in messages:
A discount offered by text or email may not exceed 15% or $10, whichever is
lower, without the owner's approval. Offers must state an expiry date no
more than 14 days out and must say "one per customer".
sections.Required wording:
Every marketing text must end with "Reply STOP to opt out". Every message
must name the restaurant.
sections.Audience size:
A single campaign may go to at most 500 customers without owner approval.
Campaigns to customers who have not ordered in more than 180 days need owner
approval regardless of size.

sections.Remakes and comps:
Any barista may remake a drink the customer is unhappy with, no questions
asked, and may comp a drink or pastry up to $10 to fix a mistake we made.
A lead may comp up to $20 on a single order. Anything above $20 needs the
owner.

Comps are for our mistakes and for service problems. We do not comp for
friends or family. Staff drinks are free during a shift and are rung in as
staff drinks, not comps.

Comps for the week should stay under 2% of the week's gross sales. The
owner gets a weekly comp report either way.
sections.Refunds:
A customer who is unhappy and still here gets a remake first. If they would
rather have their money back, refund to the original payment method the
same day. After the customer has left, a refund is available within 48
hours with the receipt or the order number from the Square Online
confirmation. Card refunds go back to the card; we do not give cash for
card payments.

No refunds on merchandise once opened, or on flights once the first cup
has been poured.
sections.Discounts:
Standard discounts: 10% for students with ID, 10% for hospital staff with a
badge, and the loyalty reward of one free drink after nine stamps. A free
loyalty drink is not a discount and may be combined with a standard
discount on the rest of the order.

Any other discount above 10% needs a lead. Any discount above 20% needs the
owner. Seasonal Specials are never discounted.
sections.Online orders:
Square Online orders are pickup only. An order not collected within 30
minutes of its ready time is discarded and charged in full. If we were
late making it, the customer is not charged and the order is remade on
request.
sections.Catering:
Catering orders need 72 hours' notice and a 50% deposit. The deposit is
refundable up to 48 hours before pickup and kept after that. Catering orders
over $300 need the owner's confirmation. We do not deliver catering; it is
pickup only.
sections.Allergies:
We cannot guarantee any drink or pastry is free of dairy, nuts, or gluten
and staff must say so when asked. Oat and almond milk are prepared on the
same equipment as dairy.

sections.Who may receive texts:
A customer who has ordered in the last 90 days and gave us a phone number
has an existing relationship with us and may receive up to two marketing
texts in a calendar month on that basis, without a separate opt-in. Anyone
outside the 90-day window needs verified SMS consent, meaning they texted a
keyword to our number or ticked the box at checkout.

Loyalty messages, meaning a stamp balance or a free drink reward, are not
marketing and may go to any customer with a phone number on file. They must
not include an offer.

Anyone who has unsubscribed receives nothing, including loyalty messages,
until they opt in again.
sections.Quiet hours:
No text between 9pm and 8am Mountain time. We assume all customers are
local.
sections.Frequency:
Two marketing texts a month under the existing-relationship rule. Four a
month for customers with verified consent. Email once a week at most.
sections.Offers in messages:
A discount in a text or email may not exceed 20% without the owner's
approval. Seasonal Specials may never be discounted in a message. Offers
expire within 7 days and apply once per customer.
sections.Required wording:
Every marketing text ends with "Text STOP to stop". Every message names
Ridgeline Coffee.
sections.Audience size:
A single campaign may go to at most 300 customers without owner approval.
Campaigns to customers who have not ordered in over 90 days need owner
approval, and may only go to customers with verified consent.

sections.Pickup orders:
Online orders are prepared in the order they arrive and marked ready in
the app. Peak mornings run 10 to 15 minutes from order to ready; the app
shows the current estimate and customers are told to trust it.

An order not collected within 30 minutes of being marked ready is discarded
and charged in full. If the order was marked ready late by more than 10
minutes, the customer is not charged and may have it remade.

Drinks that were wrong are remade on the spot. We do not refund an online
order once the customer has taken it from the counter, except under the
48-hour refund rule in the house policy.
sections.Loyalty program:
Customers earn one stamp per drink purchased, in store or online, when they
give their phone number at checkout. Nine stamps earn a free drink of any
size from Signature Drinks, House Favorites, or Matcha. Seasonal Specials,
Flights, and Bubble Tea are excluded from the free drink.

Stamps expire 12 months after they are earned. A free drink reward expires
60 days after it is issued. Stamps are never transferred between phone
numbers.

Giving a phone number for loyalty is not consent to marketing texts; see
the messaging policy.
sections.Gift cards:
Gift cards are sold in any amount from $10 to $200 and never expire. They
cannot be redeemed for cash, and a card with a remaining balance under $5
may be cashed out at the customer's request where state law requires it.
Lost cards are replaced only if the original purchase receipt is shown.
sections.Order problems we cannot fix online:
Allergy notes, custom milk ratios, and extra-hot requests placed through
the app are best-effort. If an order comes out wrong because of a note the
app did not pass through, it is remade and not charged.
